transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get the package-lock routine going for the Midnight Arcade delivery package. I have final approval authority, but before I can sign off, I need each department to report any required changes. We've got the current draft package listing worldwide delivery, our standard music credit, a 4K UHD 24fps master, English subtitles, and a June 14 publicity release. Rights, post-production, and publicity — please go through the draft and flag anything that needs to be adjusted. Once I've heard from all three departments, I'll review and approve the final package.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I reviewed the countersigned music license this morning, and there's a problem with the current draft. The license restricts distribution to the United States and Canada only — not worldwide. Also, the required credit must be exactly 'Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs,' not our standard music credit. I haven't entered the countersigned terms into the delivery tracker yet because the rights database migration is still open, but these changes need to be reflected in the package before approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a major post-production issue. I received the broadcaster's completed ingest test today, and it confirms that delivery must be an IMF package at 25 fps with English SDH captions — not the 4K UHD 24 fps master and ordinary English subtitle file currently listed in the draft package. The current draft specs will fail the partner's ingest specification. I've kept the ingest test result in the post-production test folder pending this meeting, but these changes are required before Mara can approve the package.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a publicity issue. I confirmed with the artist's representative this afternoon that publicity for the special is embargoed until June 21 — not June 14 as currently listed in the draft package. The representative will reject any public release dated earlier than June 21. I should note that the approval email is still attached to the publicity calendar rather than the delivery tracker, so it hasn't been captured in the formal delivery system yet.
transcript.speaker: A4
